Use <th> for header cells, and colspan or rowspan for merged cells. Copy each cell exactly as printed, including ±, units, footnote marks and words such as NA. Write subscripts inline (Nb1.5TaTiZr0.5). Don't add, compute, convert or summarize anything. If there is no table on the page, answer NO TABLES.
